# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## I. PLACEMENT & MARKING GAMES
### A. Light/Illumination
- Akari (place light bulbs with constraints)

### B. Number Placement
- Sudoku (place 1-9 in rows/columns/blocks)
- Nansuke (fill blanks with numbers from list)
- Makaro (fill rooms with sequential numbers)

### C. Cell Coloring/Shading
- Hitori (color cells to eliminate duplicates)
- Kurodoko (color black cells based on number constraints)
- Nurikabe (fill black cells forming continuous wall)
- Nuritwin (shade cells in equal pairs)
- Usowan (color cells with one wrong number per region)
- Sto-stone (color cells that fall to bottom half)

### D. Shape Placement
- Shakashaka (place triangles in squares)
- LITS (color tetrominoes in regions)
- Tilepaint (color tiles to create outlines)

## II. LINE-DRAWING GAMES
### A. Single Closed Loop
- Dotchi-Loop (loop through white circles)
- Masyu (loop with circle constraints)
- Slitherlink (connect dots to form loop)
- Yajilin (loop avoiding black cells)
- Mid-loop (loop with black circle midpoints)
- Moon-or-Sun (loop alternating moon/sun cells)
- Suraromu (loop through numbered gates)
- Nagareru (loop following wind direction)

### B. Path Connection
- Numberlink (connect pairs of numbers)
- Hashiwokakero (connect islands with bridges)

## III. DIVISION & BLOCKING GAMES
### A. Rectangle Division
- Shikaku (divide into rectangles by number)
- Double Choco (divide into blocks with mirror pairs)

### B. Block/Region Formation
- Chained Block (form connected black blocks)
- Five Cells (divide into 5-cell blocks)
- Fillomino (divide into same-numbered blocks)
- Sashigane (divide into L-shaped blocks)
- Norinori (place two black squares per region)
- Heyawake (paint cells in rooms with constraints)

## IV. MAZE & MOVEMENT GAMES
### A. Maze Creation
- Nurimeizu (create maze from S to G)

### B. Object Movement
- Satogaeri (move circles to countries)
- Yosenabe (move circles into gray areas)

## V. GRID-FILLING WITH CONSTRAINTS
### A. Pattern Completion
- Evolomino (draw squares on arrows with growth)
- Pencils (mark and draw from pencil tips)

### B. Constraint-Based Filling
- Choco Banana (paint black rectangles avoiding loops)
- Ripple Effect (fill rooms with consecutive numbers)
- Juosan (fill cells with horizontal/vertical lines)
- Hebi (place snake segments 1-5)
- Kurotto (color cells counted from circles)
- Nurimisaki (color with promontory constraints)
